requirements.rule: ELEMENTO PEREQUATIVO (Sez. Quarta Tit. IV Art. 13, pp. 177-178): 485 euro a year with the June pay to the worker in service on 1 January of a company without second-level bargaining (EmployerProfile.second_level_premium false), for the months of the year before over twelve; the engine pays it (parameters.equalisation_element). Left open: the pay above the CCNL the worker received in the year before (superminimi, premi annui, other pay subject to contributions) has no field in the request; the engine reads it from the individual elements of the run, each amount on 31 December of the year before at the part-time fraction, for each month served, on twelve monthly payments, so an element agreed since, the share of the extra months or a yearly premium of the year before is not seen. A run without the employment period pays none; a second-level element the employer states counts when in force in the year before.
requirements.remediation: State the pay above the CCNL of the year before as a fact of the run, or pass the element as a bonus and leave the employer flag true.

requirements.rule: Art. 9 (Sez. IV Tit. III): the holidays of letters b and c in a sickness or a work injury reach 100% (sickness_rules.holiday and insured_absence.injury.holiday). Not calculated: the holiday top-up during pregnancy and puerperium, the patron saint substitute and 29 June, a letter b holiday in Rome only, outside the national calendar.
requirements.remediation: Top up pregnancy and puerperium holidays, the substitute patron holiday and Rome-only 29 June when the applicable local facts are stated.

requirements.rule: LEAVE, PAR (Sez. Quarta, Titolo III, Art. 5, renewal of 22 November 2025 p. 33): the settore siderurgico (EmployerProfile.subsector steel) accrues 124 hours in place of 104, and the turnisti on 15 or more weekly shifts including the night shift (Employment.qualifying_shifts) 8 hours more. Not modelled: the 8 hours of the siderurgico turnisti, paid with the 13th; the further 4 hours from 2027 at 18 or more weekly shifts and 4 more from 2028 at 21 for the non siderurgico workers; and the hour of the sottosettori of the accordo of 16 July 1979 for the workers in service at 31 December 2012.
requirements.remediation: Add employment facts for 18 and 21 weekly shifts with night work and for the historical sottosettore, accrue their hours, and pay the siderurgico shift hours with the 13th.

requirements.rule: PART-TIME ELASTIC CLAUSES (CCNL 5 February 2021, PDF p. 57): 10% for a rearranged placement of the hours and 15% for an increase in duration up to 25% of the normal annual part-time hours. The request has no field for the hours of an elastic clause.
requirements.remediation: Add an optional fact for the hours worked under an elastic clause and pay its 10% or 15%, then resolve this limitation.

requirements.rule: MULTI-WEEK SCHEDULE: the premiums of the orario plurisettimanale of Art. 5 as renewed on 22 November 2025 (15% Monday to Friday and 25% on Saturday, 20% and 30% for sudden needs, raised by 8% from the 81st hour, p. 32 of the signed scan) are not modelled. The night work of Art. 7 is in supplement_bands: 20% before 22 (FED_NOTTURNO_FINO_22), 30% after 22 not on shifts (FED_NOTTURNO_OLTRE_22), the shift workers 25% from 22 to 6 (FED_NOTTURNO_TURNI) or 20% in the impiantistiche activities over the 24 hours (FED_NOTTURNO_TURNI_IMPIANTI, role impianti_24h); their night-holiday rates of rows h) and i) (60%, 35%; 65%, 40% from 22 to 6) are not modelled. The shift column of the overtime of Art. 7 is: OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI, OT_NOTTURNO_TURNI_EXTRA and OT_NOTTURNO_FESTIVO_TURNI for an event with in_periodic_shift.
requirements.remediation: Model the multi-week premiums of Art. 5 and the night-holiday rates of the shift workers with a fact naming the schedule of the worker, then resolve this limitation.
